lines.text: A long time ago, in a galaxy far, far away.
Episode Four. A New Hope.
War burns across the stars. From a hidden base among the outer worlds, a small rebel fleet has struck the first real blow against the Empire, and lived.
Hidden in the memory of a stolen droid are the plans to the Empire's new battle station: a fortress the size of a moon, with power enough to end a world.
Pursued by the Emperor's agents, Princess Leia runs for home, carrying the one secret that can still save her people.
Above a forgotten desert world, a rebel corvette is running for its life.
And out of the dark behind it comes something the size of a city.
Hull breach on deck four! They have us in a tractor beam!
Eleven thousand tonnes of consular ship, swallowed whole.
The corridor goes very quiet. Then the doors come off their hinges.
And through the smoke walks the thing every soldier aboard had heard about, and hoped was only a rumour.
Where are the plans you intercepted? I will not ask a second time.
This is a consular ship. We carry no transmissions, we are on a diplomatic mission to...
Tear the ship apart.
But the plans are already gone, folded into the memory of one small astromech with a stubborn streak.
Find the old man on the desert world. Give him this. You are my only hope.
One escape pod, no life signs aboard. The gunners let it fall.
Two droids. A thousand kilometres of sand. And no plan whatsoever.
We are doomed. Do you hear me? Doomed. And I blame you entirely.
By dusk, a sandcrawler had them both.
On a moisture farm at the edge of nowhere, a boy watches two suns go down, the way he has every evening of his life.
There is a whole galaxy out there. And I am here, fixing evaporators.
He does not know it yet, but the war has already come looking for him.
An old hermit in the hills. A locked chest. A weapon from a cleaner age.
Your father's lightsaber. He would have wanted you to have it, when you were old enough.
The Force surrounds us. It binds the galaxy together. Learn to listen, and it will tell you what your eyes cannot.
Then teach me. I want to learn.
Thirty pilots against a moon.
The trench is two metres wide and eleven kilometres long, and every gun on that station is watching it.
Red Five, standing by. Cutting in now, stay on me.
The Force is strong with this one. I have you now.
Let go. Trust yourself.
He switched off the targeting computer. And fired.
The battle station burns. The war is not over. Not by years.
But tonight, in a hall of white stone, a farm boy, a smuggler and a princess stand in the light, and the galaxy remembers how to hope.
